# macdoc

> A safe, local-first macOS CLI that explains why a developer Mac is full and slow, and gets space back without surprises.

macdoc scans your Mac, shows where space and memory go, and suggests cleanups from a fixed recipe catalog. It deletes nothing by itself: a person approves each removal at a real terminal.

## Commands

Read-only (safe to run any time):
- `macdoc doctor`, `macdoc doctor scan`, `macdoc doctor dev [toolchain]`, `macdoc doctor projects`, `macdoc doctor software`, `macdoc doctor explore [path]`, `macdoc doctor status`, `macdoc doctor slow`, `macdoc log`
- Every command supports `--json` (schemas in `schema/`).

Plans and removal (Terminal, person only):
- `macdoc plan` seals a dry-run plan from opportunity IDs (never paths). It changes nothing.
- `macdoc apply <plan>` asks per item before removing. There is no `--yes`. Agents must not run it.
- `macdoc quarantine restore|purge` also belong to the person.

## MCP server

`macdoc mcp` lets an AI assistant diagnose and propose plans. It cannot apply, delete, move, restore, accept a path or run a command. The person runs the returned `macdoc apply P-...` in Terminal.
